mentions.name: Movie & series watch tracker (Airtable + n8n)
mentions.description: This app tracks movies and series watched with a partner. The user inputs a relevant URL and the system determines whether it points to IMDb, YouTube, or a list; an LLM then extracts the movies or series from the list and finds the relevant IMDb links. Built on Airtable with n8n for automation, it presents a masonry view of watched and unwatched items, sortable by tags, with ratings and notes.
mentions.problem: Tracking movies and series watched with a partner is an impossible task with spreadsheets being too fiddly, and the author wants to look up what is next on a phone.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I find tracking movies and series I have watched with my partner an impossible task. Spreadsheets are too fiddly for my partner, and I want to look up what is next on my phone so I have turned to Airtable and n8n for automation.

input a relevant url, it will decide if it IMDB or Youtube or a list. 
using an llm, it will attempt to extract the movies or series from the list and find the relevant IMDB link.
